title: Corticothalamic communication under analgesia, sedation and gradual ischemia: a multimodal model of controlled gradual cerebral ischemia in pig
description: A multimodal porcine dataset of corticothalamic communication recorded during analgesia, sedation, and controlled gradual cerebral ischemia followed by recovery. It includes 11 juvenile pigs monitored across sedation states (isoflurane, fentanyl, propofol), one or two ischemia episodes, and recovery phases. Animals were divided into a sedation-only group and an ischemia group.
methods_description: Juvenile pigs were surgically instrumented and monitored through sequential sedation states 1-5, followed by one or two episodes of gradual ischemia (states 6 and 8) with recovery periods between and after (states 7 and 9-12).
